name: photo-to-part
title: Photo to Part
tagline: Turn photos, a few measurements, or a messy 3D scan into a parametric part you can print or edit.
requires_hermes: >=0.23.0 for the optional Part studio pane; tools install without it

stats.tokens_note: Not stated in the README or v0.1.22 release notes.
stats.tests_note: README documents unittest discover -s tests and hermes plugins validate / doctor --ci, but does not publish a test count.
stats.source: README.md at v0.1.22; GitHub release notes for v0.1.22

features: Optional Part studio Desktop pane on Hermes 0.23+ showing stage, photo overlay, renders, history, scale/trust, approval, and output paths
Templates including plate clip, spur gear, scroll, and strap hinge; builds are local Python with an approval prompt
Validate watertight meshes and stated sizes; heal messy scans; render comparison views next to the photo
User-stated millimetre values are not replaced by a photo measurement
No credentials, no printer connection, no network from the tools; chat photos still go to your model provider
use_cases: Ask for a replacement part from a photo and a few measurements, then print a validated STL
Make a fit-test print of a plate clip (the checked-in sample is 51 × 72.6 × 6 mm in examples/plate-clip)
Turn a messy 3D scan into a healed solid with photo_part_heal, then validate and render views
Generate a spur gear from stated module, tooth count, and bore, after the template path has been tried
Model a strap hinge (one or two scrolls on a straight strap) and compare the photo overlay in the Part studio pane
Hold rendered front/iso/side/top views next to the original photograph to check the fit before you print
install:
Install the plugin/ subdirectory so evals/ and tests/ are not copied into Hermes:

hermes plugins install mojomast/hermes-photo-to-part/plugin --ref d924991f56ad4cf7b94e33f2ac5dcb6cf24fac5f
hermes plugins enable photo-to-part

Until catalog acceptance the README also shows --no-enable first so you can read the code. After catalog acceptance the reviewed install is hermes plugins install photo-to-part. Load the skill with skill_view("photo-to-part:photo-to-printable-part"). Enabling the plugin installs its Python packages from PyPI after Hermes dependency consent. A STEP solid needs CadQuery or build123d in the project environment (optional, can take several minutes). A root install without /plugin is refused.

video.note: 60-second showcase used for the submission. Re-encoded to H.264 720p, faststart, under 14 MB.
